description: Svelte teardowns read state as it was before the flush, through proxies too (docs/design/REACTIVITY-ALIASING.md, R5): an effect's cleanup and a child's onDestroy, after one write, two writes and a write in the handler that destroys the child (Svelte 5.57.1 keeps the value before the flush's first write); a derived value the cleanup reads is computed from those values. Before R5 natively the proxies read their current values (`cleanup 0/1`, `destroy 13 3`) and the derived value its cache (`d0` throughout).
